name: qore-mcp
description: Ask your Amazon, Walmart and TikTok Shop data questions in plain English — sales, ad spend, search terms, placements and catalog, from the accounts your Qore organization has already connected.
long_description:
Qore connects Claude to the marketplace and retail-media accounts your organization has already authorized in Qore — Amazon Ads and Seller Central, Walmart, TikTok Shop, Google Ads, Shopify, MerchantSpring and Jungle Scout — so you can stop exporting reports and pasting them into a chat.

Ask it "what were my top 10 products by ad sales last month?", "which search terms burned spend with no sales in the last 30 days?" or "how are today's sales tracking against yesterday, hour by hour?" and it reads the live data and answers.

**How access works.** You sign in with your own Qore account and pick one organization to connect; there is no API key to copy or paste. The connection reaches exactly the connectors you can reach in Qore and nothing more, and it is scoped to the one organization you chose at sign-in. Revoke it any time from Connected apps in Qore.

**What it can reach.** The tool surface is derived from the platforms your organization has connected, so an Amazon-only organization sees Amazon's tools. When you have more than one brand on a platform, name the brand in your question — or ask which ones it can see. Some tools change things in the connected ad account, so leave your assistant's tool-approval prompts switched on.

tools.name: list_connectors
tools.description: List the connectors this connection can reach — one authorized account on one platform, with the brand name and the slug to pass as the connector argument of any other tool.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Aggregated performance for campaigns, ad groups, keywords, targets, products or placements over a date range.

tools.name: get_timeseries
tools.description: The same performance metrics broken out by day, week or month.

tools.name: get_stats_by_hour
tools.description: Intraday performance by hour, for pacing today against yesterday.

tools.name: get_search_term_metrics
tools.description: Customer search terms with impressions, clicks, spend and sales, for finding waste and harvest candidates.

tools.name: get_campaign_placement_stats
tools.description: Performance split by placement, such as Top of Search against Product Page.

tools.name: get_entity_map
tools.description: The campaign, ad group, keyword and target hierarchy of the connected ad account.

tools.name: get_table_fields
tools.description: The fields, types and aggregations available on each queryable table.

tools.name: searchcatalog
tools.description: Search the marketplace catalog for products by keyword, ASIN or attribute.

tools.name: fetch_organization_products
tools.description: The products this organization sells, with identifiers and current attributes.

tools.name: get_bid_recommendations
tools.description: Suggested bids for keywords and targets.

tools.name: get_budget_or_bidding_rules
tools.description: The budget and bidding rules configured on the connected ad account.

tools.name: get_advertisement_target_audience
tools.description: The audiences an advertisement targets.

tools.name: get_amc_reports
tools.description: Amazon Marketing Cloud reports available to this account.

tools.name: get_amc_report_data
tools.description: Rows from a completed Amazon Marketing Cloud report.

tools.name: get_amc_subscriptions
tools.description: Amazon Marketing Cloud instance subscriptions.

tools.name: get_amc_workflow_templates
tools.description: Amazon Marketing Cloud workflow templates that can be run.

tools.name: get_pricing_plan
tools.description: The pricing plan configured for a product.

tools.name: get_pricing_plan_stats
tools.description: How a pricing plan has performed.

tools.name: get_str_capabilities
tools.description: Which search-term report capabilities the connected account supports.

tools.name: get_user_info
tools.description: Identify the upstream account one connector reads as. This says nothing about the caller.
